import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants (strip whitespace)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    # Fix island label variants (standardize case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.capitalize()
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (handle commas)
    if df['body_mass_g'].dtype == 'object':
        df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
